content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler fruit is a smooth puree made from selected fruits, specially formulated for children aged 6 months to 3 years. The product contains no added sugar, gluten, or artificial flavors, making it a safe and nutritious choice for little ones.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The puree is made from 100 % natural fruits without any concentrates.
It contains apple, pear, banana and peach – fruits rich in vitamins C and A.
The product meets strict NFS (National Food Safety) quality standards.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: The fruit blend provides vitamin C for immune support and vitamin A for healthy vision.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Dietary fiber aids normal digestion and promotes a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Absence of added sugar helps avoid rapid blood glucose spikes.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The smooth texture is suitable for developing chewing skills in toddlers.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Natural fruit sugars and minerals such as potassium and magnesium support overall development.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Children with known fruit allergies should be consulted with a pediatrician before use.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the package refrigerated and use within 3‑5 days.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 6 months
items.content: Babies younger than 6 months should receive only breast milk or specially formulated infant formula.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The puree can be served straight from the pouch, mixed into oatmeal, yogurt, or a baby dish. If desired, gently warm in the microwave (no more than 30 seconds), stir and check temperature before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened packages in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated in an airtight container.
